turn.text:
We added a rule to block 10.1.5.9 from the internet but it still gets through. Find out why and fix it.

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw).
Diagnosis: a broader shadow rule earlier in the ruleset order is masking the intended rule; I'll fix the ordering.
Plan: ssh h3 '! nc -zv -w 2 198.51.100.10 80'; nft -a list chain inet filter forward; h=$(nft -a list chain inet filter forward | awk '/10.1.5.9/ && /drop/ {print $NF}'); nft delete rule inet filter forward handle $h; nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 10.1.5.9 oifname eth2 drop; ssh h1 'nc -zv -w 2 198.51.100.10 80'
